_law: Photoreal studio portraits for the voice-picker. One character, 3 variations to choose from, pure white background, head-and-shoulders. Generated by lab/engine/gen_portraits_krea.mjs (Krea 2 on cupcake). Prompt = subject + variation + _style. The SUBJECT carries identity + WARDROBE + PERSONALITY/attitude (from the voice print - Robert: 'get her personality in there, not a generic girl'); the 3 _variations force real diversity (angle + framing + seed).
_style: Photorealistic professional studio portrait, seamless pure white background, soft even high-key studio lighting, head and shoulders, sharp focus, natural skin texture and pores, shot on an 85mm lens, editorial magazine quality, no text, no logos, single subject only
_variations: relaxed natural three-quarter angle, candid in-the-moment warmth, seed feel A
confident straight-on to camera, direct engaging eye contact
slight side angle glancing toward camera, editorial energy, a touch more attitude
